title: Pass the Chicken! 🐔 Bible Review Game for Kids | God's Love is Kind | Sunday School
desc:
Catch the rubber chicken! 🐔 Today we play Pass the Chicken, a fun review game with 8 questions from the Bible stories we learned in Building Block 3: Jonah, Zechariah, the little boy's lunch, Jesus' baptism, the lost sheep, the Red Sea, the man born blind, and the centurion's servant. Can you answer them all?

At the end we discover what all 8 stories have in common: God's love is kind! 💛

📖 Memory verses: "I cried out to the Lord, and He answered me." (Jonah 2:2) and "The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want." (Psalm 23:1)
🎯 Lesson: God's Love is Kind. He forgives us, hears us, feeds us, finds us, saves us, opens our eyes and heals us. Let us be kind too!
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Pass the Chicken!
0:15 Sit in a big circle
0:25 Q1 Jonah prays
0:37 Q2 Zechariah
0:46 Q3 The little boy's lunch
0:58 Q4 Jesus is baptized
1:10 Q5 The lost sheep
1:19 Q6 The Red Sea
1:29 Q7 The man born blind
1:39 Q8 The centurion
1:48 What do they all share?
1:57 God's love is kind!
2:05 Be kind this week
2:14 Prayer
